title: Memory held for too long by the BRC queue while the owning thread is detached
author: kumaraditya303
body_preview: On the free-threaded build, when a non-owner thread decrefs an object and ob_ref_shared drops to zero, the object is queued for its owning thread and is only freed when that thread next runs Python code. If the owner stays detached for a long time — blocked on a lock, in a syscall, waiting on a pipe — the queued objects stay alive for as long as the owner is blocked. title: Type expression arguments aren't recognized as `TypeForm` when the parameter type is a union containing a `TypeForm`
